item.name: Granular separation
item.description: Separation of coarse and fine grains with a vibrating membrane.

background.text: Mixed grain sizes obstruct a collection channel.

technical_problems.statement: Mixed grain sizes obstruct a collection channel.

technical_solutions.statement: A perforated membrane vibrates at 90 Hz to separate coarse grains from fine grains.

evidence.excerpt: Synthetic granular separator study. All apparatus and observations in this document are invented for isolated software tests. Mixed grain sizes obstruct a collection channel. A perforated membrane vibrates at 90 Hz to separate coarse grains from fine grains. The apparatus includes a perforated membrane, a support frame and a collection tray. The support frame holds the membrane above the collection tray. Fine grains pass through the membrane into the collection tray. Coarse grains remain above the membrane. No separation efficiency or material composition is specified.
